title: BottleExp
description: A Paper Plugin that Adds Multiple Utility Commands to Help with Experience Bottles on Servers!
body:
Bottle Exp is a Paper Plugin That Improves The Overall Minecraft Experience for Experience and EXP Bottles. Made for Players and is a Lightweight plugin.
It was made in a day to replicate the Famous Earth MC Bottle XP Plugins.
Some Utilities Include:


```
/b mend
```
 : Spend Experience on the go to mend an item as much as you can![Picture of Players Mending Items](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4c1b2dee9378028075da13905c3521c84838266d.png)


```
/b stats
```
: shows your stats on experience like how much you have![Picture of a Players Stats on Experience](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/96b0abb41c29e87d797036b8c85daae865bb5332.png)


```
/b store  <EXP> <BOTTLES>
```
 : Stores That Much Experience into custom bottles for you store on the go![Picture of Custom Experience Bottle](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/87ee20641a8e77770eb6299f0c72a426b15cbfcd.png)



```
/b convert
```
 : Absorbs EXP Bottles for you instead of having to Splash them![Picture of Players Converting Experience directly](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c092ea92725334f8d0c546dc933004840781d20a.png)


```
/b help
```
 : Shows More Commands like this!

[Help Screen](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ad3cc7c4e6af8e93c3532ce2ca540e8fbf5be764.png)
